items.title: Inflation Accelerated in October, PCE Index Shows
items.content: The Personal Consumption Expenditures index picked up in September, according to data released a day after the Federal Reserve’s decision to hold interest rates steady.

items.title: U.S. GDP Increased 3.4% in Third Quarter
items.content: The economy grew 3.4 percent in the third quarter, the fastest pace in a year. Strong spending and growth contrast with the poor marks many voters are giving the economy.
